feed.title: Google Cloud: Developer Connect
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Developer Connect

entry.summary: Developer Connect insights are now generally available, providing valuable information for developers. This release signifies a major step in making these insights readily accessible to all users.
entry.title: Announcement: Developer Connect Insights Now Generally Available

entry.content: VPC Service Controls support for Developer Connect is generally available. For instructions on using this feature, see Using VPC Service Controls.
entry.summary: VPC Service Controls for Developer Connect are now generally available. This feature enhances security by allowing you to control access to your Developer Connect resources within your VPC Service Controls perimeters. For detailed instructions, refer to the Using VPC Service Controls documentation.
entry.title: Feature: Developer Connect VPC Service Controls Now GA

entry.content:
For GitLab Enterprise and Bitbucket Data Center connections, Developer Connect now checks permissions on the calling principal.

When you create or update repository connections, Developer Connect uses Secret Manager secrets to authenticate to third-party Git providers. Previously, these referenced secrets were retrieved by the Developer Connect service agent (P4SA) on your behalf, checking permissions only against the P4SA's credentials rather than those of the calling principal. To adhere to the security principle of least privilege, Developer Connect now checks permissions on both the calling principal (using end-user credentials) and the P4SA, to ensure both have the secretmanager.versions.access IAM permission on the referenced secrets.

This check only affects GitLab Enterprise (GLE) and Bitbucket Data Center (BBDC) connections.

For instructions and more details, see the Developer Connect security bulletin.
entry.summary: Developer Connect now verifies permissions for GitLab Enterprise and Bitbucket Data Center connections. This update ensures that both the calling principal and the service agent have the necessary access to secrets, enforcing the principle of least privilege.
entry.title: Security: Enhanced security for Git connections

entry.content: You can now create an account connector using a custom OAuth client.
entry.summary: You can now create an account connector using a custom OAuth client. This provides more flexibility in configuring your connectors.
entry.title: Feature: Account Connector Custom OAuth Client

entry.content: You can now use Git proxy with account connectors.
entry.summary: Account connectors now support Git proxy. This allows for more flexible and secure Git operations when configuring connectors.
entry.title: Feature: Git proxy support for account connectors

entry.content: Developer Connect now supports HTTP connections, for access to arbitrary HTTP endpoints.
entry.summary: Developer Connect now allows access to arbitrary HTTP endpoints through its new HTTP connections feature. This enhancement expands the capabilities for developers to interact with various web services directly.
entry.title: Feature: Developer Connect Adds HTTP Support

entry.content: You can now connect to Secure Source Manager using Developer Connect.
entry.summary: Developer Connect now supports connections to Secure Source Manager. This new integration allows you to seamlessly connect your repositories hosted in Secure Source Manager. Explore the documentation to learn more about setting up this connection.
entry.title: Feature: Connect to Secure Source Manager
